verdict.rationale: Entrust provides no-code Workflow Studio to build automated verification workflows and webhooks that let workflows run asynchronously and notify status changes without manual polling, which is a form of background automation. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-oriented autonomy (e.g., scheduled/triggered agent tasks, self-directed decision-making, or integration with AI agent frameworks) beyond identity-verification workflow execution. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent/autonomous-agent orchestration, scheduling/triggering mechanisms beyond webhooks, and evidence of independent (non-vendor) confirmation of background automation reliability.
